verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports linking an intention (spec) to a PR (Foreloop-Intention: YOUR-REF, @foreloop link) and exposes projects/loops/intentions/stories/tasks via a CLI usable by developers or coding agents to start implementation, which covers the core of pulling a spec into the delivery workflow. However, there is no explicit 'approval' gating step before pulling a spec, and no independent/hands-on evidence of this end-to-end flow working in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of an approval status/gate on intentions before implementation, and third-party confirmation of the CLI-to-PR handoff working as documented.
